title: Regression: SSH connections fail with "Invalid executable path" in Nightly Builds after NB3228
author: aldweb
body_snippet:
### Description

I have encountered a regression in mRemoteNG affecting SSH connections in Nightly Builds newer than NB3228.

When attempting to establish an SSH connection, mRemoteNG displays the following error:

`Invalid executable path: path contains potentially dangerous characters or sequences (Parameter 'PuttyPath')`

### Steps to reproduce

1. Launch mRemoteNG using an affected Nightly Build.
2. Attempt to open an SSH connection.
3. Observe the error message.
